1. (Currently Amended) A method of treating Argininosuccinate Synthetase Deficiency (ASD), the method comprising administering to a subject in need of treatment a composition comprising an mRNA encoding argininosuccinate synthetase (ASS1) at an effective dose and an administration interval such that at least one symptom or feature of the ASD is reduced in intensity, severity, or frequency or has its onset delayed, wherein the composition is administered directly to the liver of the subject by intravenous injection.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the mRNA is encapsulated within a liposome comprising a cationic lipid, a non-cationic lipid, a cholesterol-based lipid, and a PEG-modified lipid in a molar ratio of approximately 40:30:20:10.

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Cancelled)

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 2, wherein the cationic lipid constitutes about 30-50% of the liposome by weight.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 2, wherein the ratio of cationic lipid to non-cationic lipid to cholesterol to PEGylated lipid is approximately 40:30:20:10 by molar ratio.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 2, wherein the liposome comprises a combination selected from: cKK-E12, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; C12-200, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; HGT4003, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; or ICE, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 2, wherein the liposome has a size less than about 100 nm.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the effective dose ranges from about 0.1 to 5.0 mg/kg body weight.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the composition is administered intravenously.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the composition is administered once a week.

14. (Cancelled)

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the administering of the composition results in reduced citrulline level in the subject as compared to the baseline citrulline level before the treatment.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the administering of the composition results in reduced ammonia level in the subject as compared to the baseline ammonia level before the treatment.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the mRNA is codon optimized.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the codon-optimized mRNA comprises SEQ ID NO:3.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the mRNA comprises one or more modified nucleotides.

20. (Cancelled)
